entries.title: Psalms 88:1
segments: ¶<<A Song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. To the Chief Musician. Set to "Mahalath Leannoth." A Contemplation of Heman the Ezrahite.>> O LORD, God of my salvation, I have cried out day and night before You.

entries.title: Psalms 88:2
segments: Let my prayer come before You; Incline Your ear to my cry.

entries.title: Psalms 88:3
segments: For my soul is full of troubles, And my life draws near to the grave.

entries.title: Psalms 88:4
segments: I am counted with those who go down to the pit; I am like a man [who has] no strength,

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
segments: Adrift among the dead, Like the slain who lie in the grave, Whom You remember no more, And who are cut off from Your hand.

entries.title: Psalms 88:6
segments: You have laid me in the lowest pit, In darkness, in the depths.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
segments: Your wrath lies heavy upon me, And You have afflicted [me] with all Your waves. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 88:8
segments: You have put away my acquaintances far from me; You have made me an abomination to them; [I am] shut up, and I cannot get out;

entries.title: Psalms 88:9
segments: My eye wastes away because of affliction. LORD, I have called daily upon You; I have stretched out my hands to You.

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
segments: ¶Will You work wonders for the dead? Shall the dead arise [and] praise You? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 88:11
segments: Shall Your lovingkindness be declared in the grave? [Or] Your faithfulness in the place of destruction?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
segments: Shall Your wonders be known in the dark? And Your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
segments: But to You I have cried out, O LORD, And in the morning my prayer comes before You.

entries.title: Psalms 88:14
segments: LORD, why do You cast off my soul? [Why] do You hide Your face from me?

entries.title: Psalms 88:15
segments: I [have been] afflicted and ready to die from [my] youth; I suffer Your terrors; I am distraught.

entries.title: Psalms 88:16
segments: Your fierce wrath has gone over me; Your terrors have cut me off.

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
segments: They came around me all day long like water; They engulfed me altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 88:18
segments: Loved one and friend You have put far from me, [And] my acquaintances into darkness.
